response.original_title: Official-Guide How do I add another room to my Princess Cruise?
response.overview: Yes, 1-844-666-6040 (US/Canada) you can add another room to your Princess Cruise if cabins are still available on your sailing, though you generally need to book it as a separate reservation and ask Princess or your travel advisor to link the bookings. To add an extra room or stateroom to an existing Princess Cruises 1-844-666-6040 (US/Canada), you cannot do it online or through the mobile app. Call 1-844-666-6040 (US/Canada) customer service or your travel agent: Reach out to Princess Cruises customer service directly at 1-844-666-6040, or contact the travel advisor who handled your original reservation. To add another stateroom to an existing Princess Cruises reservation, you must book a separate cabin through Princess Cruises 1-844-666-6040 (US/Canada) or your travel advisor and have the two bookings linked, as adding a second room cannot be done directly in an existing online reservation.
